definitions.short: to pounce as a bird of prey
definitions.full: H2907. tus [ טוּשׂ ] verb rush, dart (Aramaic , טוּס fly ) — only Qal Imperfect אֹ֑כֶל עֲלֵי יָטוּשׁ כְּנֶשֶׁר Job 9:26 like a vulture , which rusheth upon its food (simile of swiftly passing days of Job's life).
